Synopsis:
Bristol's Forwards Festival (featuring Lorde, Little Simz, Wet Leg) is being run on clean power — hydrogen and renewable-charged batteries — under a publicly-funded Clean Power Pilot (CPP) scheme. Backed by the West of England mayoral authority and Bristol City Council, the scheme grew from a Massive Attack low-carbon concert. Act 1.5 is coordinating the initiative and is in discussions to expand it to other UK regions and internationally. The article is primarily a human-interest/sustainability feature with no market pricing or supply/demand data.
